paite: Huan sialluang chiang bangkhat piakin ka oma: huan angelin, Ding inla, Pathian biakin leh maitam leh huaia bete teh in:
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise, and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

paite: huan biakin a huangsung nusia inla, the ken; namte kianga piaksa a hihtak jiakin; huan kho siangthou tuh a khe nuai un kha sawmli leh kha nih a sikden ding uhi.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

paite: Huan ka palai nihte kiangah ka pe dia, huan amau tuh saiip puan silhin ni sang khat leh ni zanih leh ni sawmguk thu a genkhol ding uh a chi a.
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

paite: Hiaite tuh olive sing nihte leh khawnvak koihna hihte, leitunga Toupa maa dingte ahi ua.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

paite: Huan mi kuapeuhin amau suknat atup un tuh, a kam ua kipana mei hongsuak khiain a melmate uh tuh a nezou vek dia; huan kuapeuhin amau hihnat a ut un tuh, huchibangmaha thahin a om ngei ding uhi.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

paite: Hiaiten tuh a thu genkholh sung ua vuah a zuk louhna dingin, van khak theihna a nei ua; huan a ut hunhun ua sisan suaksak dingin tuite tungah thu a nei ua, huan leitung leng gawtna chitenga gawt dingin thu a nei uhi.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

paite: Huan a thu theihpihna uh a zoh chiang un, huai gamsa guam khuk akipana hongpawt khiain amau tuh akidou pih dia, huan amau a zou dia, huan amau a that ding.
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

paite: Huan a luang utuh kho thupi kholak ah a oma, huai tuh kha lam thu ah Sodom leh Aigupta huailai maha Toupa uh kilupa a omna tuh ahi.
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

paite: Huan mite leh chite leh paute leh namte laka kipan mite a luang uh ni thum leh a kimkhat a en ua, aluang uh hana vui a phal kei uhi.
english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

paite: Huan leitunga tengte amau tungah akipak ua, kipahna bang a bawl ua; huan thilpiakte khawng a kikhak tuah ua; hiai jawlnei nihten amau leitunga tengte a thuakgim sak jiak unn.
english: Those who dwell on the earth rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

paite: Huan ni thum leh a kimkhat nungin, Pathian akipanin hinna hatna tuh amau ah a honglutta a, huan amau tuh a khe un a dingta ua; huan amau mu tengteng tungah nakpia launa a hongomta hi.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

paite: Huan van akipanin aw thupitak a zataua, Hiai lamah hongpai tou un, chiin. Huan amau tuh mei lakah vanah a pai touta ua; huan amelmate un tuh amau a mu ua.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies saw them.

paite: Huan huai dakin jinling thupitak a omta a, huan khopi mun sawma khen mun khat a chimta a; huan huai jinlingin mi sang sagih thahin a omta ua; huan a dangte tuh alauta ua, vana Pathia kiangah thupina a peta uhi.
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

paite: Tunggikna nihna tuh a beita a: ngaiin, tunggikna thuma a hongtung pah ding hi.
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

paite: Huan angel sagihnain a pengkul a mutta a; huan van ah uh aw thupi taktakin a juita a, Khovel lalgam tuh i Toupa-a leh a Kris-a honghita a; huan ama tuh khantawnin vai a hawm ding, a chi ua.
english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

paite: Huan upa sawmnih leh li a laltutphah tung ua Pathian maa tuten tuh a mai un nuai a si ua, Pathian beta ua.
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

paite: Na tungah ka kipak uhi, Toupa Pathian aw Bangkimhihthei, omlel leh omsa; na thilhihtheihna thupi na lak tak jiakin leh vai na hawmtak jiakin.
english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was TR adds “and who is coming” ; because you have taken your great power, and reigned.

paite: Huan namte tuh a hehta ua, huan nang hehna tuh a hongtungta a, huan misite vaihamsak hun leh na sikha jawlneite kiang toh, misiangthoute kiang toh, na min kihtate milian leh mineute kiang toha a kipahman uh piakna hun leh leitung hihsete hihsiata a om samna hun uh tuh a hongtungta, chiin.Huan vana om Pathian biakin tuh honin a omta a; huan biakin sunga thukhunna bawm a hong kimuta a; huan khophia bang, aw bang, van- ging bang, jinling bang leh gial thupiin a juita hi.
english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints, and those who fear your name, to the small and the great; and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

paite: Huan vana om Pathian biakin tuh honin a omta a; huan biakin sunga thukhunna bawm a hong kimuta a; huan khophia bang, aw bang, van- ging bang, jinling bang leh gial thupiin a juita hi.
english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.
